title: Drago Warrior Tower Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in Drago Warrior Tower Defense, an epic strategy tower defense game where ferocious dragons threaten a trapped warrior hero! As the last guardian, summon legendary heroes, command powerful dragons, and deploy diverse towers to build an impenetrable defense against waves of dark monsters. The core idea is tactical placement and skill activation—unique for its dragon-commanding mechanics, hero spells, manual targeting, and fiery boss battles that blend classic TD with mythical fantasy flair!
